x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
import math

if n >= y:
    g = math.gcd(x, y)
    numerator = x // g
    denominator = y // g
else:
    min_diff = 1e20
    numerator = 0
    denominator = 1
    ratio = x / y
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        floor_val = math.floor((x * i) / y)
        diff_floor = abs((floor_val / i) - ratio)
        if diff_floor < min_diff:
            numerator = floor_val
            denominator = i
            min_diff = diff_floor
        ceil_val = math.ceil((x * i) / y)
        diff_ceil = abs((ceil_val / i) - ratio)
        if diff_ceil < min_diff:
            numerator = ceil_val
            denominator = i
            min_diff = diff_ceil

print(f"{numerator}/{denominator}")
